meta.title: 从0开始学摄影｜第十四期

scenes.context: 贩卖机、扶梯背面、停车场都能拍；拍人像侧重点在人物本身。
sentences: You don't need a fancy location.
那我们侧重点是在人像这个位置。
The focus should be on the person.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达随处可拍
Any everyday spot can be your studio.
换种说法表达人像重点
For portraits, the subject matters more than the scene.
scenes.speak: Like this vending machine, or even a parking lot. You don't need a fancy location — for portraits, the focus should be on the person.

scenes.context: 让模特左脸受光，人物别放最中间，避开粗壮干扰物。
sentences: 你的左脸 轻轻的受一点点光就可以了。
Just let a little light touch your left cheek.
把人物就不要完全的放在最中间。
Don't place the subject dead center.
我们可以等一下后面这辆车。
We can wait for that car behind.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达轻微受光
Let just a hint of light fall on one side of the face.
Frame the shot off-center and wait for the car to pass.
scenes.speak: Just let a little light touch your left cheek. Don't place the subject dead center. We can wait for that car behind.

scenes.context: 顶光是长条形光，让模特后退观察光线变化，证件照风格专注眼神。
sentences: 但是它是一个长条的光。
But it's a long, narrow strip of light.
你要完全去关注它的眼神。
paraphrase: 换种说法表达长条顶光
The overhead light here comes in a long beam.
换种说法表达专注眼神
Let the eyes carry the whole frame.
scenes.speak: But it's a long, narrow strip of light. Now slowly step backward and watch how the light changes on your face. Focus completely on the eyes.

scenes.context: 有线条的墙先给侧面营造侧光，脸上有明暗对比和过渡。
sentences: Start by turning to the side.
turn to the side（转向侧面）
That turns it into side light.
脸上一定会有 明暗的对比和过度。
Your face will have clear light-and-shadow transitions.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达营造侧光
Angle yourself so the light rakes across your face.
换种说法表达明暗过渡
The face gains depth through soft falloff between light and shadow.
scenes.speak: Start by turning to the side. That turns it into side light, and your face will have clear light-and-shadow transitions.

practice: Don't place the subject dead center.
用「strip of light」表达长条光
It's a long, narrow strip of light.
Turning to the side turns it into side light.
pitfalls: 偏中心构图更有呼吸感
顶光也能出证件照风格
侧光有明暗对比更立体
shifts: 人物为主体、环境为背景
footer_notes: 来源：从0开始学摄影｜第十四期（小红书，时长3分41秒）
